example.title: North Rock Creek Masonry Arch Bridge
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (Category:North Rock Creek Masonry Arch Bridge)

brief: Double stone arch county-road bridge-culvert of local limestone (date unknown, by comparison probably 1930s): smooth-faced arch stones each with a rusticated keystone, rock-faced blocks in the walls, stone foundations, and a low solid parapet. Set in a creek bottom of cottonwoods between pasture and cropland; a wooden cross stands on the roadside nearby.

traits.masonry: limestone, smooth voussoirs with rusticated keystones
